SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.BOOK_DATE AS bookDate, IFNULL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, B.SUBJECT_NO) AS subjectNo, B.CD_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, B.CCY AS oCcy, B.HAPPEN_AMT AS balance, B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS num, B.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bAmt, B.B_CCY AS bCcy, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN B.SUBJECT_NO ELSE C.FSUBJECT_ID END ) AS fsubjectId, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN #{bottomLevel} ELSE C.SUBJECT_LEVEL END ) AS subjectLevel, 0 AS dAmt, 0 AS cAmt, NULL AS isleaf, B.TABLE_ID tableId FROM BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL B JOIN BOK_VOUCH_MAIN A ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = B.SUBJECT_NO
WHERE A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
